post_text:
@The Peninsula Paris was named Europe's best luxury city hotel at the 2026 World Travel Awards Europe, held on 17 October in Kotor, Montenegro.

Among the winners for our readers' markets:

– Europe's best new hotel: The Chancery Rosewood, London
– France's best luxury hotel: InterContinental Paris Le Grand
– France's best heritage hotel: @Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel
– France's best resort: Hôtel du Palais, Biarritz
– Monaco's best hotel: Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo
– Switzerland's best hotel: Beau-Rivage Palace, Lausanne
– England's best luxury hotel: The Langham, London

It was the 33rd European edition of the awards founded by @Graham Cooke.

The signal: Paris keeps several of Europe's top city-hotel titles, while London's newcomers are already winning.

Which of these winners would you have chosen?
